entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit, your partner in performance. Please hold for the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is Charlie. How can I help you today?
Hi Charlie... I'm calling about an order. I... I'm just so disappointed. I saved up for this new jersey and I was so excited to get it.
I'm sorry to hear there's an issue. To get started, could I get your order number?

Yes, it's VF-8821-4590. It's the Aero-Weave jersey. It's just the wrong size, it's way too tight in the shoulders. I can barely zip it up. I've been a loyal customer for years and this has just really bummed me out.
I can certainly understand the disappointment when something doesn't fit right. Let me pull up that order. Okay, I see the jersey was delivered 12 days ago. I can definitely help you with this.
Oh, really? I was so worried I'd be stuck with it. That's such a relief.

Of course. Since it's within our 90-day return period, we have a couple of options. We can process a return for a full refund, or I can set up an exchange for a different size. Which would you prefer?
An exchange would be perfect, if that's possible. I'd love to try the next size up.

Absolutely. I've just processed the exchange for you. I'm sending a prepaid return label to your email on file now. Just send the original jersey that was too tight back to us, and we'll ship out the new size as soon as the return is in transit.
Thank you so much, Charlie. You've really helped me out. I was feeling so guilty about having to call.
It's my pleasure to help. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
No, that's everything. Thank you again.
You're very welcome. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a great day.
